card.name: Author names in nutrition references
card.fires_on: Pieces of author surnames (Leung, Wu, Lee, Koebnick, Stahl) and page-number digits in citations of nutrition papers, such as green tea, antioxidants and diet studies.

modes.label: Author surname pieces
modes.description: Start or middle of a researcher's surname in a reference list or in-text citation on a nutrition topic.
modes.example: Antioxidant activity of black tea vs. green tea. Journal of Nutrition. 132 (April):785. Le<<ung>>, L.K., et al.

modes.label: Page digits in journal citations
modes.description: A digit in the page range of a Journal of Nutrition style citation.
modes.example: protects against ultraviolet light-induced erythema in humans. J Nutr 2001;131:1449-<<5>>

card.writes: It nudges output toward nutrition and health-promotion words, though the promoted tokens are mixed and weak.
card.plain: It lights up on researchers' names and page numbers inside citations of diet and green tea studies.
